Fiberglass swimming pool shells are classified in HTSUS 9506.99 (other articles and equipment for general physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics, other sports, or outdoor games; swimming pools). Heading 9506 covers "swimming pools and wading pools" at 9506.99.</br>

Customs rulings (e.g., NY N301516 and similar) classified fiberglass in-ground pools under 9506.99.2000 or 9506.99.6080. The sub-breakdown of 9506.99 is: 9506.99.05 (Racket sports and others), 9506.99.15 (Articles and equipment for... ), 9506.99.20 (Other: Of textile materials...), 9506.99.25 (Of wood), 9506.99.28 (Of plastics?), 9506.99.60 (Other). The most plausible is 9506.99.6080 (Other: Other).

Actually, I recall the heading 9506.99.55 ("Other: Other: ... Other") being for items like these. The current statistical structure: 9506.99.05 Racket sports; 9506.99.10 Articles for sport fishing; 9506.99.15 Other; 9506.99.20 Of textile materials; 9506.99.25 Of wood; 9506.99.28 Of plastics; 9506.99.55 Other: Other; 9506.99.60 Other. I'll go with 9506.99.6080.
